Which of the following statements are true regarding the function [MATH: ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits} ewcommand{\cosh}{\mathop{ m cosh} olimits} ewcommand{\sinh}{\mathop{ m sinh} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits}y=\sech{x}?]

  1. The function is increasing over [MATH: (0, \infty).]

  2. The function has a vertical asymptote.

  3. The domain of the function is [MATH: (-\infty, 0) \cup (0, \infty).]
EXPLANATION
sections.readable_text: EXPLANATION

sections.normalized_html:
Let's recall the graph of [MATH: ewcommand{\sech}{\mathop{ m sech} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits} ewcommand{\arsinh}{\mathop{ m arsinh} olimits} ewcommand{\arcosh}{\mathop{ m arcosh} olimits} ewcommand{\artanh}{\mathop{ m artanh} olimits} ewcommand{\arsech}{\mathop{ m arsech} olimits} ewcommand{\arcsch}{\mathop{ m arcsch} olimits} ewcommand{\arcoth}{\mathop{ m arcoth} olimits} ewcommand{\cosh}{\mathop{ m cosh} olimits} ewcommand{\sinh}{\mathop{ m sinh} olimits} ewcommand{\csch}{\mathop{ m csch} olimits} ewcommand{\coth}{\mathop{ m coth} olimits}y=\sech{x}.]

Let's now examine our statements in turn.

  • Statement I is false. The function [MATH: y=\sech x] is decreasing over [MATH: (0, \infty).]

  • Statement II is false. The function has no vertical asymptotes.

  • Statement III is false. The domain of the function is [MATH: (-\infty, \infty).]

Therefore, none of the statements are true.
